name: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Academic fees for Indian students: Rs 6,55,000 per instalment x 4 instalments (2 per year) = Rs 26,20,000. Excludes refundable institute deposit (Rs 20,000) and hostel deposit (Rs 20,000), hostel (three-sharing, Rs 1,57,300 in year 1) and mess (Rs 59,800 per instalment in year 1); hostel/mess may rise up to 15% a year; government taxes extra.
programs.intakeNote: Official pages conflict: the SIBM mobile MBA page states intake '240 Students' while the desktop MBA page states '180 students' (both retrieved 2026-11-11). Reservations within intake: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, PwD 3%; international 15% and 2 Kashmiri-migrant seats above intake.
programs.placementNote: Official CRP 2025 report for the MBA batch of 2024-26: highest CTC Rs 74.84 LPA, average Rs 28.18 LPA, median Rs 27.00 LPA; 110+ recruiters; 132 PPOs. Not stated as audited.

selectionProcess.name: SNAP 2026 test
selectionProcess.weightage: 50 marks (SNAP score out of 60 scaled to 50)
selectionProcess.detail: Shortlisting for GE-PI on SNAP score; SIBM shortlist declared 19 Jan 2027.

selectionProcess.name: Group Exercise (GE)
selectionProcess.detail: Online GE-PI(-WAT) conducted by SIBM Pune, 3-7 and 10-14 Feb 2027; attendance at all components mandatory.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interaction (PI)
selectionProcess.detail: Final merit list (out of 100) published 26 Feb 2027.

selectionWeightage.note: Common SNAP 2026 final-merit weightage as published on the official SNAP site; SIBM's own MBA page also mentions a Written Ability Test without weightage.

keyDates.notes: For MBA 2027-29: SNAP registration & payment closes 25 Nov 2026; SNAP CBT dates 13, 19 and 26 Dec 2026 (best of up to 3 attempts); SNAP result 12 Jan 2027; SIBM programme registration closes 12 Dec 2026; shortlist 19 Jan 2027; GE-PI slot booking 20-24 Jan 2027; GE-PI 3-7 & 10-14 Feb 2027 (online); first merit list 26 Feb 2027; fee deadline 13 Mar 2027; programme starts 2 Jun 2027.
